name: interactive-xapi-designer
description: Create, instrument and package SLS HTML5 activities with verified xAPI reporting.

interface.shortDescription: Build SLS activities with optional guided support and xAPI
interface.longDescription:
Developer toolkit for teachers and educational-content authors building client-side HTML5 learning activities for Singapore Student Learning Space (SLS). Create new HTML/ZIP activities or add xAPI reporting to existing ones while preserving their interface and learning logic by default. Choose Integrate only, Integrate and improve, or Build or redesign.

For each creation or integration, the plugin offers an optional choice: no guided support, step-by-step Slow Solve, a spoken Coach, or both. Support is opt-in and activity-specific. The plugin inspects the model, authors a small adapter, and reuses shared support engines and verified xAPI libraries without changing transport code. Coach speech uses browser-provided speech synthesis, remains under learner control, and does not use microphone input.

Reports can include checked answers, first/latest results, revisions, selected support use and committed simulation changes. Apply the full Prompt Library design workflow to fresh builds and explicit redesigns. Each SLS ZIP includes human-readable and machine-readable provenance with the authored prompt, concise iteration log, authoring platform, model and effort when reported, file hashes and verification notes. Unavailable model settings are marked not-reported. Filenames distinguish genuinely scored work from unscored work.

Outputs are source files and SLS-ready ZIP packages. The plugin does not host an LMS, provide a standalone tutoring service, or automatically connect to student records. Generic control use is not proof of mastery. Local browser/mock-LRS tests do not establish live SLS attribution or rendering; teachers must review and test their deployed activity.
capabilities: Optional Slow Solve and spoken Coach
defaultPrompt: Add xAPI to this HTML/ZIP; keep its UI. Ask whether I want None, Slow Solve, Coach, or both.
Integrate this interactive with xAPI and make targeted improvements. Ask whether I want none, Slow Solve, Coach, or both.
Build a fresh SLS interactive using the Prompt Library design principles. Ask whether I want none, Slow Solve, Coach, or both.
